findings.detail: A Total Debt Investments subtotal row has no coupon or spread terms and should not be carried as a PRIVATE_CREDIT position requiring interest_rate.

rationale: X02 flags a PRIVATE_CREDIT row with blank interest_rate and basis_spread. In the raw SOI for the current March 31, 2023 schedule, individual debt positions list rates in the Investment column, while the debt row without rate terms is the aggregate Total Debt Investments subtotal. That source row is not an investable private-credit instrument, so the missing-rate warning reflects a real subtotal-leak data error rather than a legitimate missing coupon disclosure.
